articles.title: U.S. government digital dollar set to be banned tonight under housing law's CBDC limit
articles.snippet: Despite President Donald Trump's refusal to sign Congress' bipartisan housing bill, it's set to go into effect at midnight, and its temporary CBDC ban along with it.

articles.title: Senate Democrats call for hearings into Trump’s ties to crypto amid CLARITY Act discussions
articles.snippet: Five senators called for committee hearings to investigate US President Donald Trump’s policies potentially being influenced by crypto funding from United Arab Emirates-linked and other entities.

articles.title: US CBDC ban to go into effect without Trump signoff on housing bill
articles.snippet: Donald Trump confirmed on social media that he would not sign the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, which includes a ban on a US CBDC until the end of 2030, setting the stage for the bill to become law on Saturday.

articles.title: Democrats Call for Senate Hearings on Trump's Massive Crypto Profits
articles.snippet: Top Democrats on key Senate committees demanded inquiries into the more than $1.2 billion that President Trump made on crypto last year.

articles.title: Trump Won't Sign Housing Bill With CBDC Ban—Will It Become Law Tonight Anyway?
articles.snippet: Unless President Trump vetoes the bill, it will become law at midnight, banning the Federal Reserve from developing a CBDC until 2031.
